roadmap.title: Opening journey and first crystals
roadmap.description: Rescue Sarah, claim the ship, and obtain the Mystic Key. Revisit locked treasuries, then restore the Earth and Fire Crystals.

roadmap.title: Airship and remaining crystals
roadmap.description: Raise the airship, bring Rat’s Tail to Bahamut, and restore the Water and Wind Crystals. Collect Adamantite and obtain Excalibur.

roadmap.title: Complete collections and defeat Chaos
roadmap.description: Finish the chest and enemy checklists, visit every area, and raise the party to level 50. Defeat Chaos, save the completed game, and return for any remaining cleanup.

achievements.summary: Earn the other 23 FINAL FANTASY achievements.

steps.text: Complete every other achievement; Master of I then unlocks automatically.

achievements.description: Cross the rebuilt bridge north of Cornelia after rescuing Princess Sarah.
achievements.summary: Cross the rebuilt bridge north of Cornelia after rescuing Princess Sarah.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Garland} in the Chaos Shrine, then cross the rebuilt bridge north of Cornelia.

achievements.description: Restore the light of the Earth Crystal.
achievements.summary: Restore the light of the Earth Crystal.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Vampire} on Cavern of Earth B3 and take the @item{Star Ruby}.
Give the Star Ruby to the giant in @loc{Giant’s Cave}. Leave through the north exit and speak to Sadda in @loc{Sage’s Cave} for the @item{Earth Rod}.
Return to B3 and use the Earth Rod on the stone beyond Vampire’s room. Descend to B5 and defeat @enemy{Lich}.

achievements.description: Restore the light of the Fire Crystal.
achievements.summary: Restore the light of the Fire Crystal.

steps.text: Speak to the sages in the eastern clearing of @loc{Crescent Lake} to receive the @item{Canoe}.
Follow the rivers west of Crescent Lake to @loc{Mount Gulg}. Reach the southwest room on B5 and defeat @enemy{Marilith}.

achievements.description: Restore the light of the Water Crystal.
achievements.summary: Restore the light of the Water Crystal.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Bottled Faerie} for 40,000 gil at the caravan in the desert west of Onrac.
Enter @loc{Gaia}, then speak to the released faerie at the northeast pond to receive @item{Oxyale}.
Return to @loc{Onrac}. Speak to the woman at the eastern dock and board the barrel to enter @loc{Sunken Shrine}.
Descend to 1F and defeat @enemy{Kraken} at the Water Crystal.

achievements.description: Restore the light of the Wind Crystal.
achievements.summary: Restore the light of the Wind Crystal.

steps.text: Take the @item{Rosetta Stone} from Sunken Shrine 5F. Reach its northeast room by following the northwest passage off the edge of the map.
Show the stone to @npc{Unne} by the graves in northeast @loc{Melmond}. Visit @loc{Lufenia} and speak to the man in the southeast for the @item{Chime}.
Canoe up the river near Onrac into @loc{Waterfall Cavern}. Speak to the robot in the southwest room for the @item{Warp Cube}.
Enter @loc{Mirage Tower} in the northeastern desert. Use the 3F teleporter, climb @loc{Flying Fortress}, and defeat @enemy{Tiamat} on 5F.

achievements.summary: Receive Bahamut’s titles of courage.

steps.text: Take the @item{Levistone} from @loc{Cavern of Ice} after defeating Evil Eye. Visit the desert south of Crescent Lake to raise the airship.
Enter @loc{Citadel of Trials}, speak to the old man, and sit on the northwest throne to reach 2F.
On 2F, use the first teleporter outside the arrival room. In the next rooms, choose the north, bottom-left, south, bottom-right, south, and right teleporters in that order.
Enter the room east of the last landing point and collect the Potion. Leave that room and follow the southwest passage. Use the bottom-left teleporter, then climb the stairs to 3F.
Follow the 3F passage around to the throne room and take the @item{Rat’s Tail} from its chest.

Fly to the island with two cave entrances in the @loc{Dragon Caves} and enter the right-hand hole. Go south on B1 and descend to B2. Follow the northern passage and give the Rat’s Tail to @npc{Bahamut}.

achievements.description: Defeat Chaos and restore peace to the world.
achievements.summary: Defeat Chaos and restore peace to the world.

steps.text: After restoring all four crystals, return to @loc{Chaos Shrine} and examine the central orb to travel to the past.
Climb to the central room on 3F. Defeat Death Eye and use the @item{Lute} on the stone to open the descent.
Descend to B5, defeating the four stronger fiends along the way. Defeat @enemy{Chaos} in the central room.
Finish the ending and credits, then create the marked completion save. If the achievement has not appeared, return to the title screen and load that save.

achievements.summary: Obtain Excalibur.

steps.text: Collect @item{Adamantite} from the southwest room on @loc{Flying Fortress 2F}.
Give the Adamantite to the smith in the northwest room of @loc{Mount Duergar} to receive @item{Excalibur}.

achievements.summary: Open the hidden 15 Puzzle aboard the ship.

guide.context: Completing the puzzle is unnecessary. With the default keyboard controls, hold Enter and repeatedly press Backspace.

steps.text: Defeat Bikke’s pirates in @loc{Pravoka} to obtain the ship. Board it, hold the confirm button, and press cancel repeatedly until the 15 Puzzle opens.
Leave the puzzle and finish a battle if the achievement has not appeared.

achievements.description: Reached level 50 for all party members.
achievements.summary: Raise all four party members to level 50.

steps.text: Fight enemies on @loc{Flying Fortress 5F} while searching for Warmech, then keep fighting until all four party members reach level 50.

achievements.summary: Defeat 100 monsters in total.

steps.text: Keep winning battles until you have defeated 100 individual monsters. Groups contribute several monsters toward the total.

achievements.summary: Defeat 300 monsters in total.

steps.text: Keep winning battles until you have defeated 300 individual monsters. Groups contribute several monsters toward the total.

achievements.summary: Defeat 500 monsters in total.

steps.text: Keep winning battles until you have defeated 500 individual monsters. Groups contribute several monsters toward the total.

achievements.summary: Fill 10% of the bestiary entries.

steps.text: Fight new enemy types as you explore. Check @mechanic{Extras → Bestiary} on the title screen for missing numbered entries.

achievements.summary: Fill 50% of the bestiary entries.

steps.text: Fight new enemy types as you explore. Check @mechanic{Extras → Bestiary} on the title screen for missing numbered entries.

achievements.summary: Fill all 128 bestiary entries.

guide.context: Check Extras → Bestiary on the title screen to find missing entry numbers. The stronger fiends in the past shrine have separate entries. After defeating Chaos, save the completed game; load that save and fight a battle if the achievement has not appeared.

achievements.summary: Visit every map location.

steps.text: Visit the towns and dungeons during the story, then check the world map’s location list for unfinished visits.

Enter the optional @loc{Matoya’s Cave}, @loc{Caravan}, @loc{Citadel of Trials}, and every entrance in the @loc{Dragon Caves}. Visit @loc{Gaia}, @loc{Lufenia}, @loc{Sage’s Cave}, and @loc{Waterfall Cavern} as well.
Enter @loc{Flying Fortress} after the other areas. If the achievement has not appeared, leave the dungeon and finish a battle.
